available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`).

region.description: Location where the component applies. Can be a zone or node.

power_systems_type.description: Corresponding type to be used in PCM modeling.

technology_efficiency.description: MWh of electricity per unit of output. Ex: MWh per ton of hydrogen for electrolyzers.

price_per_unit.description: Price or value per unit of output. Ex: USD per ton of hydrogen for electrolyzers. Units: USD/t.

min_power.description: Minimum operation of demandside unit as a fraction of peak demand. Units: 1.

peak_demand_mw.description: Peak demand value in MW. Units: MW.

max_demand_delay.description: Maximum number of hours that demand can be deferred or delayed (hours). Units: h.

max_demand_advance.description: Maximum number of hours that demand can be scheduled in advance of the original schedule (hours). Units: h.

demand_energy_efficiency.description: Energy efficiency associated with time shifting demand. Represents energy losses due to time shifting. Units: 1.

shift_variable_cost.description: Variable operation and maintenance costs associated with flexible demand deferral/advancement. Units: USD/MWh.

curtailment_cost.description: Energy cost of curtailed demand, USD per MWh. Units: USD/MWh.

max_demand_curtailment.description: Maximum fraction of demand that can be curtailed. Units: 1.

requirements.description: List of requirement IDs associated with the component.
